test_title: PYST 53: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0d4e243d4b52b61e82c802e9d530d0e9d5089949fdad7c77c62939107fb7df.png] 

Given letter-clusters:

XZW

MNL

RSQ

IJH

Observe the pattern:

In three clusters, the letters follow the pattern:

1st letter → +1 → 2nd letter → −1 → 3rd letter

Check each option:

Option 2: MNL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a6fc55b096b5da50c13848f8bae653c5314040ba51a29e18b643d064ff54144.png] 

Option 3: RSQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/265fedddcaebd00328452c9bebf19f10e46b38b478f544e8b1dda2737a1b202c.png] 

Option 4: IJH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43d1630f974dd93c079784ea910a904d130a9e06d4b3424745ee46d6d58b8524.png] 

Option 1: XZW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5881deec0b21b240343966c6641fce1ff0687c0524db9e4dcce9929bd691562b.png] 

This does not follow the same pattern.

Therefore, the odd one out is: XZW

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
